groups.text: Q9. Approximately how much time have you saved by using the “Multistep” or “25 Steps” function comparing with not using this function? [Select one answer]

items.text: Approximately how much time have you saved?
constraints: 1=More than 50%; 2=26 - 50%; 3=11 - 25%; 4=Up to 10%; 5=No time saved; 6=It takes more time now; 7=I don't know. These are categorical responses, not numeric percentages.

groups.text: Question 11: Please indicate how much you agree or disagree with the following statements related to the “Multistep” or “25 Steps” function of the BD pumps. [Select one answer for each statement]

items.text: Statement A: “It is difficult to understand and rectify alarm messages when using the ‘Multistep’ or ‘25 Steps’ function.”
constraints: 1=Strongly agree; 2=Agree; 3=Disagree; 4=Strongly disagree; 5=I haven't used it.

items.text: Statement B: “It is easy to suspend, pause, stop or change the rate of delivery, and it is clear when this has been completed when using the ‘Multistep’ or ‘25 Steps’ function.”
constraints: Same scale as q11a.

items.text: Statement C: “Setting the delivery rates for each step when using the ‘Multistep’ or ‘25 Steps’ function is NOT easy, and it is unclear when this has been completed correctly.”
constraints: Same scale as q11a.

items.text: Statement D: “I have had more time to concentrate on clinical care when using the ‘Multistep’ or ‘25 Steps’ function.”
constraints: Same scale as q11a.

items.text: Statement E: “The prompts were useful as they act as a reminder to return to the patient to complete vital signs checks before moving to the next infusion step.”
constraints: 1=Strongly agree; 2=Agree; 3=Disagree; 4=Strongly disagree; 5=I haven't used it; 6=Not applicable to me. Present the BD neXus-specific prompt and allow Not applicable to me for non-users.

warnings: The questionnaire instruction at block 50 says Q2-Q8 use a scale from 1 to 5 or ranking, but Q2 explicitly and the SAV dictionary define a 1-7 scale. The question-specific Q2 scale takes precedence.

The SAV dictionary supplies no value labels or explicit binary codes for q1_1-q1_11, q1_98, q12_1-q12_5, and q12_98. These multiple-response items are preserved with null/empty allowed-code lists and require analyst confirmation before SPSS validation is finalized.
The SAV dictionary supplies no value labels for ranking variables q5_1-q5_5 and q8_1-q8_5. Ranking bounds and uniqueness are taken from the questionnaire, not inferred from option positions.
The document contains front-matter PICOT descriptions for other questionnaires, but only the explicit PICOT 1 Multistep / 25 Steps questionnaire with mapped SAV candidate variables was included.

Questionnaire source blocks do not contain an explicit qcountry question; qcountry is mapped from the supplied SAV dictionary label and is retained with source_blocks [-1] to flag missing document provenance.
The SAV labels for q6_4, q6_5, q7_2, q7_4, q7_5, and q11e are truncated or contain template text; complete item wording is preserved from the questionnaire document.
